summary: Quiet weekend across competitors: no news from Lasso, URLgenius, Button/Posttap or Amazon's link tools.
LTK says 35% of holiday sales happen before Black Friday and 67% of holiday GMV happens on LTK's own properties, pushing brands to start creator campaigns early.
Everything else found was noise (Goodreads book rankings, unrelated 'Sovrn' crypto tickers) and was left out.

items.title: The brands winning holiday aren't waiting until Black Friday: 35% of holiday GMV happens before Black Friday, and 67% happens on LTK properties
items.why: LTK is pitching brands to spend early and inside its own app (44M shoppers, $6B in purchases). It's a sign creator platforms want to keep shopping on their own turf rather than send traffic out.
